greet.speaker: Ansel Rowe
greet.text: Ah, good day! Just Ansel — I carry the post round these parts.

ask_route.speaker: Ansel Rowe
ask_route.text: Got a whole satchel of letters yet to deliver. Mind if I chat a moment while my feet rest?

chat.speaker: Ansel Rowe
chat.text: Same route every day for near twenty years now. Boots wear through faster than the badge ever will.

chat_repeat.speaker: Ansel Rowe
chat_repeat.text: Rain or shine, the post gets where it's going. Mostly.
